svg.text: Goal: Voya helps budget-conscious travelers commit to a trip with confidence by turning real travelers' day-by-day
itineraries and reported spending into transparent, month-specific cost breakdowns they can remix into their own plans.
User of Voya (a person using a browser)
Interface (I1-I13). Arrowhead points at the component that serves the request;
the reply returns on the same line. IDs match the table in Section 4.
